caption: The drawing depicts three metallic objects arranged vertically and concentrically on a plain, light beige background. At the base is a shallow, circular pan with slightly raised edges, rendered in a muted, bluish-gray color. Inside the pan near the left edge, there is an upright cylindrical object with a hollow center, colored similarly to the pan, from which extends a tall, narrow tube or pipe rising vertically from the center of the pan. Perched on top of this vertical pipe is a medium-sized cylindrical container with a fitted, flat lid that has a small handle or twisted piece protruding from its right edge. To the left, within the pan and leaning against the vertical pipe, lies a smaller, open cylindrical ring, colored like the other objects. All objects are depicted with attention to shading and highlights, emphasizing their metallic surfaces and three-dimensional forms.
title: Economy Tint Lamp
